Write a descriptive, fictional, imaginative screenplay of a mental asylum doctor ordering a schizophrenic patient to take his pills, the patient refuses, and makes him take the pills to prove they are safe. The doctor obliges, but when he opens his eyes, the patient is gone, a figment of his imagination, revealing it was the doctor that was schizophrenic the whole time.  Please use an emoji at the end of every sentence.assistant
response:
INT. MENTAL ASYLUM - DAY 🏥

Dr. Smith, a middle-aged psychiatrist, stands in front of his patient, Jack, a disheveled young man with a wild look in his eye 🤪. Jack sits on the edge of his bed, his arms crossed and a defiant glint in his eye 💪.

DR. SMITH:
Jack, it's time for your medication. You know it's good for you 📦.

JACK:
I don't want it! I don't need it! It's just a bunch of chemicals to control my mind 💥.

DR. SMITH:
(sighing) Jack, you know the risks. You know it's the only way to keep you safe 🚫.

JACK:
I don't care! I won't take it! (he stands up and blocks Dr. Smith's path) You can't make me! I won't be a slave to your pills 💔.

DR. SMITH:
(frustrated) Fine, Jack. If you won't take it, then I'll take it for you. (he holds out the pill bottle) Here, take this. (he forces the pills into Jack's mouth)

JACK:
(spitting out the pills) No! You can't do that! You're not my doctor! (he looks at Dr. Smith with a mixture of anger and fear 😱)

DR. SMITH:
(startled) What are you talking about, Jack? Of course, I'm your doctor! (he looks at the pill bottle, then back at Jack) Wait a minute... (he looks confused)

Suddenly, Jack disappears from the bed, leaving Dr. Smith standing alone in the room 🤯. Dr. Smith looks around, confused, and that's when he sees it - a figure standing in the corner of the room, looking just like him 👻.

DR. SMITH:
(stunned) No... it can't be... (he looks at the figure, and then back at the empty bed) Oh God... I'm the one who's been delusional all along 🤯.

The figure in the corner starts to speak, its voice echoing in Dr. Smith's mind 🗣️.

FIGURE:
You've been trapped in your own mind, Dr. Smith. You've been seeing Jack as a patient, but in reality, you're the one who needs help 🤕.

Dr. Smith's eyes widen in horror as he realizes the truth 🤯. He looks down at his hands, and they're shaking uncontrollably 💥.

DR. SMITH:
(whispering) I'm the one who's been sick all along... 🤯

The camera zooms out as Dr. Smith's world begins to unravel, and the figure in the corner disappears into thin air 👻.
